Appearance:

Shri B.K. Upadhyay - Govt. Advocate for the respondent/
 Order

This is the third application filed by the applicant under Section 483 of BNSS for grant of regular bail relating to Crime No.690/2021 registered at Police Station - Govindpura, District Bhopal (M.P.)
for the offence punishable under Sections 120-B, 368, 376(2)(n) of IPC and Sections 5(L)/6 of POCSO Act.
The applicant has been arrested on 12.09.2021.
Earlier two bail applications have been dismissed as withdrawn.

2. As per the prosecution story, the allegation against the applicant is that he has taken away the minor prosecutrix and committed rape upon her therefore, the aforesaid offence has been registered against him.
3.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in this case.
He is in custody since 12.09.2021.
It is further submitted that second application for bail was dismissed as withdrawn on 28.10.2022 approximately before three years and applicant is in custody since 4 and 1/2 years.
Prosecutrix in her court statement has stated that she went with the applicant on her free will and married with him.
Statement of her father has also NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:62707 2 MCRC-51526-2025 been recorded.
As per the status report 3 prosecution witnesses have been recorded and 15 witnesses are yet to be recorded.
Applicant has no criminal antecedents.
Conclusion of the trial will take considerable time

, therefore,
it has been prayed that the applicant may be released on bail.
4.
On the other hand, learned counsel for State has opposed the grant of bail to the applicant and prayed for its rejection.

sentences.text: Having taken into consideration all the facts and circumstances of the case, but without commenting on merit of the case, I am inclined to release the applicant on bail.
Consequently, bail application under Section 483 of BNSS for grant of bail filed on behalf of applicant, stands allowed.

6. It is directed that applicant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, for his regular appearance before the trial Court during trial with a condition that he shall remain present before the concerned Court on all the dates fixed by it during trial.

He shall abide by all the conditions enumerated under Section 480(3) of BNSS.
7.
This order shall be effective till the end of the trial.
However, in case of bail jump and breach of any of the conditions of bail, it shall become ineffective.
8. Certified copy as per rules.
